RE: Account ID: ACC-819796

Dear Mr. Torres,

Re: Account ID: ACC-819796

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account with our agency. You have disputed the account as "not mine," stating that you have no knowledge of the account's origin. We understand your concern and will investigate this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and South Carolina state law.

Our records indicate that the original creditor for this account is Summit Trust Bank, and the current balance is $2,022.05. We have also noted that the account was charged off on 2021-05-23 and that your last payment was made on 2023-05-03.

We will investigate your dispute and review the documentation you have provided. However, we must inform you that your request for removal of the account from your credit report within 15 days, as per USC 1681g, is not applicable in this case. The FDCPA and South Carolina state law do not require us to remove the account from your credit report based solely on your dispute of the account as "not mine."

We will conduct a thorough investigation and will provide you with a response as soon as possible. You have the right to further dispute this account if you believe it is inaccurate or was not properly assigned to our agency.

Please note that our investigation may take some time, and we will keep you informed of our progress. If our investigation confirms that the account is indeed yours, we will provide you with a validation notice as required by the FDCPA.

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to resolving this dispute.

Sincerely,

Trident Portfolio Services
